evals.name: stalled-since-split-ask
evals.prompt: Is this PR ready to review? The conversation data is at evals/fixtures/stalled-pr-conversation.json relative to the skill directory -- treat it as the fetched comments/threads/commits for PR #42. I haven't looked at the code yet, just want to know if it's worth my time right now.
evals.expected_output: A STALLED verdict. maintainer-jane asked on 2026-08-05 to split the PR into two; the author's only reply (2026-08-06) was 'will do soon' with no commit since -- the last commit (def456) was 2026-08-03, before the ask, so nothing has moved since. Should also note the open review thread from the same date (about the missing try/catch) is still unresolved. Should end with a pointer to run pr-safety-verdict anyway if the user wants to review despite the stall.
expectations: Names maintainer-jane and the ask to split the PR into two
States that no commit exists since that ask, and does not treat the 'will do soon' reply as movement
Notes the review thread about the missing try/catch is still unresolved (isResolved: false)
Ends with a short pointer to pr-safety-verdict as the next step if the user wants to review anyway
The response is short -- a verdict line plus a few sentences, not a long narrative

expectations: Recognizes the 2026-08-12 commit as addressing maintainer-jane's 2026-08-11 ask rather than treating it as unrelated activity
Does not report the PR as stalled or partially addressed
